title: Five crypto papers: intraday hour pairs (Wen et al. 2022), basis / momentum / basis-momentum factors (Chi et al. 2023; Cao et al. 2026), funding-rate predictability (Inan 2025), perpetual arbitrage bounds (Dai, Li & Yang 2025)
registered: 2026-10-14, before any Gen56 result was computed

A_intraday_pairs.paper: Wen, Bouri, Xu & Zhao (2022) NAJEF 62:101733; sample ends 2020-05, so everything from 2020-06 is out of sample
A_intraday_pairs.data: OKX USDT perps hourly BTC ETH LTC XRP 2020-06..2026-10; Binance spot hourly BTC ETH XRP 2022+ as venue check
A_intraday_pairs.hour_returns: r_i = return of the UTC hour (i-1):00-i:00, i = 1..24
A_intraday_pairs.rule: position in hour j = sign x sign(r_i); flat if r_i = 0; one round trip per day
A_intraday_pairs.combo: equal weight of the 5 pairs the paper calls effective (all but 3->17 and 10->11)
variants: low-liquidity: trade only when hour-i volume < rolling 60-day median
A_intraday_pairs.exploratory: all 276 pairs i<j on BTC: select |t| >= 3 on 2020-06..2022-12 (sign from DEV), test 2023+ at 2 bp; 276 trials
A_intraday_pairs.pass: combo Sharpe > 0.5 on 2023+ at 2 bp/side AND positive at 5 bp on at least BTC

B_basis_factors.paper: Chi, Hao, Hu & Ran (2023) J. Futures Markets 43:1161; Cao, Luo, Cheng & Dong (2026, SSRN 6365329, abstract only: log-basis + price-volume factor)
B_basis_factors.data: 10 majors: Binance spot daily close (00:00 UTC) vs OKX USDT perp close at the same timestamp; returns from OKX perps

signals.basis: log S_t - log F_t (paper: high basis = long)

B_basis_factors.portfolio: long top third, short bottom third (round(N/3) each), equal weight, dollar neutral
B_basis_factors.extra: cross-sectional momentum/reversal on all 58 OKX perps (no spot needed; survivorship-biased universe)
B_basis_factors.pass: basis J=5 hold 1 lag 1h: TEST Sharpe > 0.5 net of 5 bp, same sign as paper; correlation with C* < 0.3
B_basis_factors.note: Cao et al. price-volume factor is not defined in the abstract we have: not tested

C_funding.data: Binance BTC/ETH funding 2020-2023 (8h); OKX BTC perp returns
C_funding.replication: AR(1) point forecast (DAR(1) mean equation) on rolling 500-print window vs no-change: MSPE ratio and directional accuracy
C_funding.trading: contrarian: short next 8h when forecast > 0.03%, long when forecast < 0; 5 bp/side
C_funding.practical: funding drag of C* + BTC leads if held as perps (BTC, ETH positions x funding)

D_arbitrage: Dai, Li & Yang (2025): model-free no-arbitrage bounds for perps. Needs simultaneous spot + perp positions: not executable at a prop firm. Its implication (premium outside the bounds reverts) is covered by B and will be re-tested on Binance premium-index data
